$comment: The critical uptime test — is each live service UP? Read by scripts/estate-uptime.mjs every 30 minutes from estate-uptime.yml. A probe is a plain HTTPS GET, no browser, no sign-in, no form. A service is DOWN only when every attempt fails (status outside `expect`, or `must_contain` missing, or no answer inside the timeout). Add a service by adding a row; the pinned issue 'Estate uptime' shows the latest answer and a founder is messaged only when a row flips.

probes.name: Community platform (Omni)
probes.note: / answers 302 → landing.html; the landing page is the thing a visitor actually sees, so it is what is probed.

probes.name: Library (rendered, behind the rules door)
probes.note: A redirect to the rules gate is UP: the door is answering. Only a 5xx or silence is DOWN.

probes.name: Beacon lab
probes.note: The lab API; / has no route (404) so the probe uses /api/status (200 + labName). Runs on the Omni droplet since 2026-10-26.
